criteria.fix-now: A real defect against the spec or acceptance criteria; the approver would escalate on it
criteria.follow-up: Real but outside this job's spec; worth a bead, not a round

instructions.question: What should happen to this reviewer Note?
instructions.judge_by: The lens, severity and confidence, the file path, whether earlier rounds raised a Note on the same path, and the Note text when it is given. Choose fix-now only for a defect the approver would escalate.

criteria.approver: Might be a real defect or out of scope; leave it for the approver to read

instructions.question: Can this reviewer Note be settled without the approver?
instructions.judge_by: Only the lens, severity, confidence, file path and whether earlier rounds raised a Note on the same path; the Note text is not given. Choose fine only when the metadata clearly points to a low-value Note; otherwise choose approver.
